name: ESO 320-14 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 320-14, an amorphous irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: e32014-hubble
story: ESO 320-14 is an irregular galaxy that keeps to itself, away from the strong pull of big neighbors. Hubble measured its distance in a study of how galaxies stream away from the Centaurus A/M83 complex.

claims.text: E320-14 is an amorphous irregular galaxy targeted by Hubble program 10235
E320-14 is also KKs44, with a new Hubble TRGB distance in a study of the Hubble flow around the Cen A/M83 complex
E320-14 is an isolated galaxy (negative tidal index)
